title: Resolve container filesystem capacity without broadening the device inventory
goal: Vision: V-6. Repair the preexisting host_metrics current-directory test failure on overlay-root containers while preserving filesystems() device-backed inventory semantics and public APIs.

reuse.searched: Reused host_metrics /proc/mounts parsing, path-prefix selection, and the existing statvfs FFI and saturation helper. filesystems() remains device-only; Linux filesystem_of() resolves the requested path against all mount points before measuring only that mount. No new dependency or unsafe operation.

limitations: Local-only task under parent coordination; no external board messages, commit or push. Linux x86_64 verified; Windows and unsupported-platform code is unchanged but not executed here. This correctness fix is not a source reduction or proof of the under-100k goal. All 60 added physical lines count under the current metric.
